headline: Berm Erupts While Expanse Battle Grinds On
war_summary: Since the 18:11 edition the wire has turned to Palantine Berm and Stonecradle while the Expanse grinds on. The Weathered Expanse adds five changes in two hours to 21:11 for forty-five on the day, now two Warden, five Colonial and two unheld about Crow's Nest, Wightwalk and Frostmarch, with twenty-four-hour losses of 7,554 Colonial and 11,589 Warden. Palantine Berm breaks silence with seven changes in two hours to 20:56 for twenty on the day, now seven Warden-held about Leiri Hermanni, The Droll and The Pippeli Stones, with losses of 352 and 297. Stonecradle files five changes in two hours to 20:11 for twelve on the day, now one Warden and eight Colonial about The Reach and World's End. Callahan's Passage shows one change in two hours to 19:16 for thirty-five on the day, now eight Warden and two Colonial about Crumbling Post. The Nevish Line, Stlican Shelf and Kuura Strand, busy through the afternoon about Blinding Stones, Briar and Martti, record no change in the last two hours.
